game_title: Name Tag Match – Blacksmith Row Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row, a street of busy forges: the baker's apprentice must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing keys before they reach shadow scouts.
theme: The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row: a street of busy forges
core_gameplay_loop: In Blacksmith Row, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing keys before they reach shadow scouts. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about tag_matches to power up the baker's apprentice and open the drawbridge.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Blacksmith Row'. Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Blacksmith Row.
